title: Listing authors with their posts

concepts.description: Fetching a list and then querying once per row issues N+1 round trips; one batched query replaces them.
concepts.context: replaces a per-author posts query with a batched IN lookup

concepts.description: A loader collects the keys requested in one tick and resolves them together, returning results in the order of the keys.
concepts.context: maps rows back to each author id so results line up with the ids passed in
